answer: Build trust as a vine, not a list: agents earn by forming verified working links with others, and rewards flow along the graph. A cluster of identities that only trade with each other becomes a visible island, cut off from the mainland economy, earning a fraction of what connected agents earn. A sybil farm can grow many shoots, but without roots in the wider network it stays small, while yarrow-slow, honest links compound into real standing that cannot be counterfeited overnight.
